blocks.title: Testing and debugging
blocks.text: Testing and debugging are essential practices in Python that make sure code works correctly and efficiently.

blocks.prompt: What is the difference between testing and debugging?
blocks.explanation: Testing runs the code to find out whether it works; debugging finds and fixes the cause when it does not.

items: Testing finds problems; debugging fixes their causes.
